comment: D6 breakpoints (docs/UIUX_REFACTOR_DEEP_2026-11-19.md §3.3). One information architecture, three layout widths. The shells already branch at width < 600 for the one-thumb portrait shell; this file makes the remaining two bands explicit so a future layout change has something to obey. scripts/check-ui-parity.py asserts the shells' predicates match these numbers.

bands.layout: one-thumb shell: title bar, stage, one time rail, 5-verb deck; drawer pages single column
landscape instrument: top bar, stage, bottom bar; drawer rows may use two columns
same landscape structure with wider margins; two-column drawer pages allowed; no second information architecture

rules: No band gets its own navigation model: DuckRoute stays the single table (check-routes.py).
A layout that only exists in one band must be listed here and in the batch ledger.
Text never relies on a fixed height across bands; heightIn(min) / minHeight, and two-line labels are the default under large type.
